findings.issue: Publication validates exampleUploadIds, but image URLs come from the separate, unchecked exampleStorageIds array. A malformed persisted draft can expose another owner's private image.
findings.reproduction: Added tests/adversarial.test.ts with a T20 fixture: create another client's private upload; seed its storage ID into a draft whose exampleUploadIds is empty; publish; retrieve as an artist. The code permits publication and projects the foreign image. Requires malformed persisted data; no public mutation path to create this mismatch was found. Test execution was blocked.
findings.recommendation: Derive published storage IDs from validated upload records atomically, or reject any mismatch before changing status.

findings.issue: Unrestricted account registration is exported publicly and offered in the UI, although the specification excludes public unrestricted signup. No invitation or approved-account restriction appears in the packet.
findings.reproduction: Call auth.signUpWithUsernamePassword anonymously with a fresh valid synthetic username/password, create a client profile, then save and publish a request. Added this reproduction to tests/adversarial.test.ts; execution was blocked.
findings.recommendation: Enforce approved demo-account provisioning or an invitation check on backend registration. Hiding the signup button alone is insufficient.

findings.issue: The publish button operates independently of the editor's unsaved changes and pending save. It can publish older content and leave the visible editor attempting to edit a request that is now immutable.
findings.reproduction: Save a draft, edit its title or amount without saving, then click Publicar encomenda on its card. RequestCard publishes only the persisted ID; the changes remain local. Saving afterward is rejected because the request is open. Also reproducible by delaying save and clicking publish before save commits. Established from source; browser execution was prohibited.
findings.recommendation: Share dirty, saving and publishing state between the editor and card. Require saving or explicitly discarding edits before publication, and prevent overlapping save/publish operations.
